violated_contract: An in-memory store double must reject every payload the production store rejects. On 2026-10-09 the dream dirty signal (#20979/#20993) wrote event refs as an array of arrays; StrictFirestore stored it, all tests passed, and production Firestore rejected every write with InvalidArgument, so the shadow cohort's queue stayed empty.
canonical_prevention: Validate payload shape inside the shared Firestore double (StrictFirestore rejects arrays nested directly in arrays on set/create/update) rather than in individual tests, so every hermetic test exercising a write inherits the production constraint.
